name: Diamond
overview: The diamond is highlighted in Scripture as a symbol of preciousness and strength, notably featured as one of the jewels in the high priest's breastplate, as seen in Exodus 28:18 and 39:11. Ezekiel 28:13 further emphasizes its value by listing it among the precious stones adorning the garden of Eden, representing divine craftsmanship. Additionally, Jeremiah 17:1 uses the diamond metaphorically to describe the enduring and deeply engraved sin of Judah, illustrating the stone's hardness and permanence.
